notes.title: v1.2.4 Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]NOTE:[/b] This update is compatible with v1.2.1 save and above.[/h3]

[b]Improved:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tyler's Satiety and Stamina will decrease at a very slightly higher rate. This was necessary because recent updates were in players' favor as it was too easy to stack up supplies.
[*] Increased the chance of meeting a mercenary enemy.
[*] New Game+ used to begin with a full backpack, now it'll be empty as it should be. However, items in the RV from the previous gameplay is not gone.
[/list]

Please do share your opinion and submit bugs if you encounter any!

notes.title: v1.2.3 Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]NOTE:[/b] This update is compatible with v1.2.1 save and above.[/h3]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a buggy situation in which player dying with a companion npc would result in loss in stat points.
[*] Fixed a bug in the clinic section where the game would trap the player in an endless loop of fights.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.2.2 Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]NOTE:[/b] This update is compatible with v1.2.1 save. However, if you're at day 15 or beyond, you might want to restart if you'd like to find the shotgun.[/h3]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] THE SHOTGUN: Found two weeks after the journey begins, it is the ultimate weapon with instant-kill guaranteed in close combat.
[*] SHOTGUN SHELL: Somewhat rare item. Usually found in stashes and night hunts. You can begin collecting them before finding the shotgun. They will be useful.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] IMPROVED: The 'punk' enemy animation used to lag when killed. It is smoother now.
[/list]

[b]Known Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] WORKING ON: A bug in which player dying with a companion npc would result in loss in stat points.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528475/ea969d47b2f98057fc2710db44fa15926e0b2a55.png[/img]

notes.title: v1.2.1 Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]NOTE:[/b] This update fixes a critical bug, but requires a new save to be created, rendering previous save files obsolete. Please update only if you accept to lose your progress![/h3]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] MERCENARIES: As you travel the country, occasionally you will encounter soldiers. They have orders to shoot on sight, make sure you collect some bullets!
[*] MAKING & BAKING BREAD: Use the microwave oven to make your own bread! For that you will need to find 'FLOUR' (new item) and of course, some water. 
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] FIXED: Fixed a bug where 'KNIFE' progress (level & damage upgrades) are reset when the game is closed.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528475/7b36a9083f9f851f535a2f0d80f984ddac6b0f5f.png[/img]

notes.title: v1.2.0 Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]NOTE:[/b] This update brings in new global variables, rendering previous save files obsolete. Please update only if you accept to lose your progress![/h3]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] EXPLORATION: Now TYLER can step outside the RV and look around. Sometimes he will just admire the view, other times he may go on a small walk to find danger or reward!
[*] COMPANION BOOST: The characters that are with TYLER are going to boost his certain stats until they part ways. Enjoy the company! 
[*] DISCARD SCRAP METAL: If his backpack is full and he needs to make room, TYLER can discard a scrap metal from the inventory. He doesn't worry, he knows he will find more along the way.
[*] BOOKS FOR GOOD MOOD: Reading books will now actually improve TYLER's mood. 
[*] HEAR MORE: Added sound effects for knife stabs and zombies approaching.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] FIXED: Two achievements now work as intended.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528475/180290bdfe9975df8676680cb46a6f07f47a4ee0.png[/img]

notes.title: v1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]NOTE:[/b] This update brings in new global variables, rendering previous save files obsolete. Please update only if you accept to lose your progress![/h3]

[b]New Feature:[/b]
[list]
[*] Choose not just a perk, but a [b]FLAW[/b]: Now the player has to choose a "flaw" for the character when starting a new game, defining your experience in a more personal way. Update 1.1 introduces four flaws to choose from (may increase in future).
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Survival mode now begins with NORMAL difficulty, as intended.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528475/6b469a48daeb395f1f9e00242de8240578e5f6d1.png[/img]

notes.title: v1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
In this small update...

[b]New Feature:[/b]
[list]
[*] To show some mercy to new players, TYLER will not be affected by 'bleeding' condition for the first week of the game timeline.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: 'Breathe' button didn't work in open areas where the zombies were approaching.
[*] Fixed: Updating the endurance stat didn't increase maximum health points as intended.
[*] Fixed: The player could get stuck in a save loop, where the empty tank and terrible stats caused death without a proper chance to improve the situtation. If player dies in a similar situation and hit CONTINUE, the game gives the player a little more fuel to proceed (than the player originally had in savefile).
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
In this small update...

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] TYLER can now catch his breath to increase STAMINA when he sees a zombie approaching!
[*] MAX Health is visible next to the current HP.
[*] On the first few days, when checking the medicine cabinet, the player will be informed to use the BANDAGE only if there is bleeding.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528475/196af6d258d2a3bcb4b8736b8342c8500ee590b1.png[/img]

notes.title: v1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
[list]
It's been 72 hours since the release and the first small update is already here!

[*] Fixed a bug where player couldn't get out of the RV when disturbed by a punk at night.
[*] Added a stat boost upon loading a game in Nightmare mode, to address the problem where player would immediately die after hitting CONTINUE button, having so little health points.
[/list]
